pages.title: Electric Mining Rig Mk-II
pages.text: The highest-tier mining rig, capable of mining the most advanced veins.$(br2)Power Draw: 10 $(efu)$(br)Speed: 1 item per 3 seconds$(br)Mines: all vein types including advanced exclusive veins

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: Use this rig when you need to mine advanced veins like Ferrium, Cuprium, and Amethyst.$(br2)Like the Electric Mining Rig, output goes to Global Storage automatically. Must be within pylon supply range.
Check the exact recipe in the Crafter. Required materials can be looked up in REI/JEI.
